title: One neighbourhood locator and a large dimensioned constraints close-up (dimension lines on the edges they measure, each naming its basis; street names with mapped widths; north arrow and scale), a compact heights table and the 'No building placed' legend entry
objective: Page 2 keeps the neighbourhood locator only (the block close-up is not printed; block_map.py and its tests stay, restorable). Page 3 becomes a large close frame: the subject lot and the lots sharing an edge with it (1, 11, 61) dominate; dimension lines anchored to the outline's edges on the only basis the 1.4.0 document has (the city map outline, gis), each labelled in plain words (e.g. '103.88 ft, map outline, not surveyed'); street names with mapped widths (Northern Boulevard 100 ft, 215 Place 60 ft), north arrow and scale bar. The page-1 graphic becomes the compact close frame (maps side only). The six height rows become a compact 3x2 standard / qualifying-housing table. The site page shows the 'No building placed' legend entry instead of the sentence. No tax-map value is drawn. The rows' 'Not known' data path (page_site_context.py:52) stays for a later task. No CSS change: every SVG is sized from its viewBox; any page-2/3 CSS need goes to the orchestrator, who relays it to the M5-T165 builder. NB-04 revision 2 adds close_frame_dimensions.py to its code_paths and every drawn edge value not yet recorded (at least 99.98 and 101.71 ft) as gis quantities; its research_status stays unchanged.
business_reason: D-094 R014/R074: the maps repeat context while the property stays small; the constraints page needs a close-up drawing with dimensions attached to the boundaries.

acceptance_scenarios.then: every dimension endpoint lies on its edge's vertices within 0.01 ft; each label names its basis; nothing is merged across bases; no tax-map value is drawn

acceptance_scenarios.given: the close frame at print size
acceptance_scenarios.then: every label is at least 8.5 pt with no collisions; the build fails rather than shrink
it is the locator only; the block_map tests stay green
its contents are as the objective states; the one-outline check and the lot-only fallback are unchanged (one line, never blank)
at most 3, each a distinct job

the 3x2 table takes its labels from the document; 'Maximum lot coverage' appears once on the site page and there is no bare 'Not shown'; without a map document there is no 'Context maps' text in the site section, with one there is an svg
the 'No building placed' legend entry shows; the not-placed sentence stays on the scenario sheet (test_report_read_context.py:68 still passes)
every frame and snapshot not changed by this task is byte-identical (the changed ones listed in the report)

acceptance_scenarios.when: its HTML visible words are counted
acceptance_scenarios.then: at most its baseline (199 on build_report_html(benchmark()))

acceptance_scenarios.given: section ids, reader questions and the page-1 wrapper
acceptance_scenarios.then: they are untouched; report/layout.py is unedited
revision 2 lists close_frame_dimensions.py in code_paths and every drawn edge value (at least 99.98 and 101.71 ft) as gis quantities; research_status unchanged; exit 0

risks: Map drawings needed 3-4 rounds in wave 22; labels at print size are the usual failure.
A CSS need would collide with M5-T165's layout.py: relay it, never edit it.
path_notes: Runs beside M5-T165 (no shared file). Builders never start a server; the report-print e2e runs in CI.
